title: 第7章 拜师风波第8章 师父的考验
slug: 满级雷灵根卷哭修仙界
lines: 玄天剑派的宗门大殿气势恢宏，白玉石柱擎天而立，上面雕刻着无数剑诀符文。
殿内早已聚集了众多前来观礼的弟子，人声鼎沸，都在期待着这一届新弟子的拜师仪式。
林枝意和其他五个单灵根小伙伴被安排在队伍最前方，他们娇小的身形在宏伟的大殿中显得格外醒目。
“哇，他们好小啊！”观礼的弟子中有人小声惊叹。
“那个白衣的是苏清雪吧？”
“那个冷着脸的小男孩是李寒风，六岁的冰灵根！”
“钱多多才五岁，金灵根的天才！”
“最矮的那三个天啊，他们真的只有三岁吗？林枝意、云逸和柳轻舞”
有眼尖的弟子注意到林枝意周身隐隐流转的金色气息“你没发现那个林枝意身上有龙气吗？应该是人皇之女。”
大殿前方，数位剑派长老端坐在紫檀木椅上，个个气息深沉，目光如电。
按照惯例，资质最佳的弟子将由地位最高的长老先选。
然而，当掌门宣布拜师仪式开始时，诡异的一幕发生了——
几乎所有的长老都将目光投向了苏清雪。
“清雪小友，”一位灰袍长老率先开口，语气温和，
“老夫修炼柔水剑法百年，正缺一位水灵根的真传弟子。”
另一位蓝衣长老紧接着道“我座下已有三位亲传，但若你愿来，老夫愿破例收你为关门弟子。”
“我虽主修金系剑诀，但可为你专门请教水系功法”
长老们你一言我一语，竟都争相向苏清雪抛出橄榄枝，仿佛她才是那个万中无一的天灵根。
五个小团子不约而同地翻了个大大的白眼。
“烦人精又要得意了。”林枝意小声嘀咕，小嘴撅得老高。
果然，苏清雪虽然面上保持着谦逊，但眼底的得意几乎要溢出来。
她最终选择了一位修为最高的青袍长老，恭敬行礼“弟子愿拜入青岚长老门下。”
青岚长老满意地捋须微笑，其他长老则面露惋惜。
【呸！都是剧情作祟！】系统在林枝意脑海里愤愤不平，【明明你的资质最好，他们却都围着那个苏清雪转！】
“意意才不屑于和她用一个师父呢！”
林枝意气鼓鼓地想着，开始在大殿中搜寻其他合适的人选。
接下来，其他小伙伴也陆续找到了心仪的师父。
李寒风被一位修炼寒冰剑诀的长老看中，两人气质相投，一拍即合。
云逸的天生剑体引起了数位剑修的争夺，最终一位专修剑意的长老如愿以偿。
钱多多虽然嚷嚷着剑修太穷，但还是被一位擅长炼剑的长老收为弟子——
毕竟金灵根在炼器方面有着天然优势。
柳轻舞的风灵根被一位以速度见长的女剑修看中，温柔的女修轻声细语地安抚着怯生生的小女孩。
转眼间，五个小伙伴中四个都已经找到了师父，只剩下林枝意还孤零零地站在大殿中央。
所有人的目光都聚焦在这个三岁的小公主身上——
天灵根的绝世天才，竟然无人问津？
content_en:
The sect hall of the Xuantian Sword Sect is magnificent, with white jade stone pillars standing high in the sky, with countless sword runes carved on them.
Many disciples who came to watch the ceremony had already gathered in the hall, and there was a buzz of people, all looking forward to the apprenticeship ceremony of this new generation of disciples.
Lin Zhiyi and the other five Shanlinggen friends were placed at the front of the team. Their petite figures stood out in the majestic hall.
"Wow, they are so small!" Some of the disciples watching the ceremony exclaimed in a low voice.
"The one in white is Su Qingxue, right?"
"That little boy with a cold face is Li Hanfeng, a six-year-old Binglinggen!"
"Qian Duoduo is only five years old, a genius with Jin Linggen!"
"The three shortest ones, are they really only three years old? Lin Zhiyi, Yun Yi and Liu Qingwu"
Some sharp-eyed disciples noticed the faint golden aura flowing around Lin Zhiyi's body, "Didn't you find that Lin Zhiyi has dragon aura in him? He should be the daughter of the Human Emperor."
In front of the main hall, several elders of the Sword Sect were sitting on rosewood chairs, all with deep breaths and lightning-like eyes.
As usual, the disciple with the best qualifications will be selected first by the elder with the highest status.
However, when the leader announced the beginning of the apprenticeship ceremony, a strange scene happened——
Almost all the elders turned their attention to Su Qingxue.
"Little friend Qingxue," an elder in gray robe spoke first, with a gentle tone.
"I have been practicing Soft Water Sword Technique for hundreds of years, and I am in need of a true disciple with the Water Spiritual Root."
Another elder in blue then said, "I already have three disciples under me, but if you are willing to come, I am willing to make an exception and accept you as a closed disciple."
"Although I major in gold-based sword techniques, I can specifically teach you water-based sword techniques."
The elders spoke to each other, and they all rushed to extend olive branches to Su Qingxue, as if she was the one and only heavenly spiritual root.
The five little dumplings rolled their eyes in unison.
"The annoying spirit is getting proud again." Lin Zhiyi muttered in a low voice, her little mouth pouting.
Sure enough, although Su Qingxue remained humble on her face, the pride in her eyes almost overflowed.
She finally chose an elder in Qingpao who had the highest cultivation level, and bowed respectfully, "This disciple is willing to become the disciple of Elder Qinglan."
Elder Qinglan stroked his beard and smiled with satisfaction, while other elders looked regretful.
【Pooh! It’s all due to plot! ] The system was indignant in Lin Zhiyi's mind, [You obviously have the best qualifications, but they all revolve around that Su Qingxue! 】
"Yiyi doesn't even bother sharing the same master with her!"
Lin Zhi thought energetically and began to search for other suitable candidates in the hall.
Next, other friends also found their favorite master one after another.
Li Hanfeng was spotted by an elder who practiced the Ice Sword Art. The two had similar temperaments and hit it off immediately.
Yun Yi's natural sword body aroused competition among several sword cultivators, and finally an elder who specialized in sword intent got his wish.
Although Qian Duoduo complained that sword cultivators were too poor, he was still accepted as a disciple by an elder who was good at sword making——
After all, Jinlinggen has a natural advantage in refining weapons.
Liu Qingwu's Wind Spirit Root was spotted by a female swordsman who was known for her speed. The gentle female cultivator softly comforted the timid little girl.
In the blink of an eye, four of the five friends had found their master, leaving only Lin Zhiyi standing alone in the center of the hall.
All eyes are focused on this three-year-old little princess——
No one cares about Tianlinggen’s peerless genius?
